seoTitle: Dr. Abhinav Somaraju Featured on The Data Shift Podcast on Enterprise AI Execution
seoDescription: Orcaworks Co-founder and Chief AI Officer, Dr. Abhinav Somaraju, was recently featured on The Data Shift podcast hosted by Charter Global, where he joined CTO Rajesh Indurthi to discuss the evolving challenges of implementing AI within enterprise environments.

body.html: Orcaworks Co-founder and Chief AI Officer, Dr. Abhinav Somaraju, was recently featured on The Data Shift podcast hosted by Charter Global, where he joined CTO Rajesh Indurthi to discuss the evolving challenges of implementing AI within enterprise environments. The conversation focuses on a critical shift organizations are experiencing as AI adoption moves beyond experimentation. While many systems perform effectively in controlled settings, the transition to real-world workflows introduces new complexities around execution, decision-making, and outcome reliability. The episode highlights how enterprise workflows are inherently multi-layered, involving interconnected processes, data dependencies, and distributed decision points. As AI becomes embedded across these workflows, ensuring consistency, traceability, and alignment with business objectives becomes increasingly important. Drawing from examples in architecture, engineering, and construction, the discussion examines high-impact workflows such as bidding, where accuracy and coordination directly influence revenue outcomes. It outlines how operational efficiency alone is not sufficient, and how organizations must also focus on managing core workflows that drive measurable business value. The discussion also addresses the growing need for governance and control in AI systems. As execution scales, organizations require clear visibility into how decisions are made, how data flows across systems, and how outcomes are produced. Establishing structured workflows and maintaining control over deployment and execution are key to building accountable and reliable AI systems. This episode provides practical insights for business and technology leaders looking to move from isolated AI initiatives to scalable, production-ready systems that deliver consistent results.
